archetypes.source_number_format_rules: Numbers are presented with commas as thousand separators and parentheses for negative values. Amounts are in thousands of dollars.

archetypes.hierarchy_rules: The EPS calculation is typically presented as a reconciliation, starting with a net income/loss figure, making adjustments, and dividing by weighted average shares to arrive at basic and diluted EPS. Indentation denotes the relationship between items.
archetypes.source_number_format_rules: Numbers are presented with commas as thousand separators and parentheses for negative values. Per share amounts are presented as decimals. Money and share amounts are in thousands.
